  Rin:            Int,
  Cin:            Int,
  Cout:           Int,
  XBitWidth:      Int, 
  WBitWidth:      Int, 
  OutBitWidth:    Int,
  minInputBits:   Int,
  minWeightBits:  Int, 
  x_slice:        Int,
  y_slice:        Int,
  w_slice:        Int,
  num_filters:    Int,
  Dma_Ids:        Int,
  DMA_Bytes:      Int,
  SCALE:          Boolean,
  DEBUG:          Boolean,
  W_BUFFS:        Int,
  DMA_bits:       Int,
  Mem_row_factor : Int,

object LUMAX_Config {
